name: Desk Transition
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Desk Transition gives Hyprland two local display actions. Desk reads active outputs and arranges them left to right by scaled width, keeping every output's mode, refresh rate, and scale. Laptop selects the first active eDP or LVDS output and focuses it without disabling another screen. The panel shows each active output's name, resolution, and focus state, and lets you focus one by click or key. Each action re-reads and validates output names. No network, credentials, or display-disable command.
